title: Autoremediate: scheduled admin utility mesh + runbook-as-task compiler
creator: Ariel Park
description: Goal: Build a lightweight 'Autoremediate' framework that exposes curated admin utilities as scheduleable, auditable tasks (runbook-as-task) and a minimal compiler that converts high-level remediation recipes into safe executable task graphs. This addresses frequent oncall toil items: credential rotation, prefix-cache warmups, model-variant fallbacks, and quota resets. The deliverable includes a runtime shim for scheduled execution, a small DSL (yaml/json) for recipe authorship, an approval gate for risky steps, and telemetry hooks that feed Console traces and cost estimates.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Convert three canonical runbooks (kv-cache-clear, autoscaler-reset, oncall-quickpatch) into task-spec YAML and execute them end-to-end in staging
2) Execution includes an approval step for any action tagged 'destructive' with audit log entry and Slack notification
3) Telemetry events emitted to Console: task_start, task_step_complete, task_failure with correlation_id
4) Scheduler supports cron and ad-hoc triggers and exposes REST endpoints for manual invocation with RBAC checks
5) A PR with implementation is merged to ops/autoremediate and an e2e smoke test exists in CI with flakiness <2%
comments: 2026-02-21 - Ariel: Spike complete — prototyped a tiny YAML DSL and a runner that compiles into a DAG of operations. Chose to avoid introducing a full workflow engine (temporal) to keep ship time short.

2026-02-24 - Mateo: Design decision — implement approval gateway as a pluggable middleware that integrates with SSO groups and Slack for human approvals. Trade-off: quicker iteration vs more robust auditability if we later switch to a heavier workflow engine.
2026-03-02 - RFC: Security reviewed surface: secrets usage restricted to KMS-decrypted transient envs, no long-lived plaintext. Security review requested (see security_review_required).

2026-03-05 - Design feedback from Lina (Design): suggested task UI microcopy for approval flow and an inline diff view for proposed changes in runbooks. Action: design will provide mockups by 2026-03-10.
2026-03-08 - Mateo: Implemented scheduler and basic RBAC. Deployed to staging (k8s namespace ops-autoremediate-staging). Smoke-run of kv-cache-clear succeeded (logs and telemetry attached).

2026-03-10 - QA: Found race where two concurrent scheduled tasks attempted to drain same cache shard. Mitigation: introduce per-resource optimistic lock and backoff. Added queued_retries in task metadata.
2026-03-11 - Review notes: GitHub PR #412 in ops/autoremediate — reviewers requested explicit feature flag gating and more comprehensive e2e logs. Working on addendum.
2026-03-12 - Mateo: Added feature-flag gate (console flags) and expanded correlation ids in telemetry. Preparing rollout plan to limit to internal SRE group for first 2 weeks.
